_note: PLACEHOLDER — emergency triggers require a SEPARATE, explicit RN review pass before approval (see governance). These force the 'get-immediate-help' band regardless of score.

triggers.message: If your parent is injured, in pain, or cannot get up after a fall, call 911. Otherwise, contact their doctor today about a falls evaluation.
A sudden, clear change in confusion or alertness can signal an urgent medical issue (such as infection or medication reaction). Contact their doctor promptly, or seek urgent care.
